'''Cimarosa''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Von Longo]] and his two sons, [[Kale Longo]] and [[Trig Longo]]. They lived on the world until sometime in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], when they were arrested by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and placed on the [[Imperial prison barge|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']].
